Pointer value `(&pCVar4->physics_box + 1)` truncated by cast to `int` (sub-pointer width) — correct on the 32-bit matching build, a hard `cast from pointer to smaller type` error at 64-bit. If the value is used as an integer (delta, address print, hash), rewrite the cast as `uintptr_t`/`intptr_t` in a .keep.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar20` self-updates via byte arithmetic on a sibling field, where the chosen field/index/constant sum to one element-size step. Replace `pCVar20->bone_list[0]` (or whatever) reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.
